comment_regular: WaterManager water-reflection render pass. Called with two NiAVObject scene roots. It creates/selects a dedicated BSShaderAccumulator, swaps it into the renderer, sets g_bWaterReflectionPassActive at 0x49C4CC, begins accumulation, renders reflected scene roots with the reflection camera/frustum, flushes the accumulator, restores the previous renderer accumulator, clears the global at 0x49C809, and then ends the scene. This is the only writer of the global.
